device_entry.name: Gilson GSIOC 兼容液体处理仪器
tags: 实验室自动化与仪器集成
device_entry.description: 采用 GSIOC 串口通信协议的 Gilson 实验室仪器，常见于液体处理、进样、输液或收集类设备。此类仪器通常用于分析化学与自动化实验流程中的样品传输、进样控制和流路操作。
device_entry.description_en: A Gilson laboratory instrument that uses the GSIOC serial communication protocol, commonly found in devices for liquid handling, sample introduction, pumping, or collection. Such instruments are typically used in analytical chemistry and laboratory automation workflows for sample transfer, injection control, and fluid-path operations.
